name: Mizanori Norihiro
source: The protagonist's classmate and the Tendou-kai student council secretary. He is an overweight otaku. Seems to want other people to call him "Nori Nori no Nori-san", but everyone just ignores him. Loves anime and games, and has knowledge on a wide range of miscellaneous things.
